sloka: निवेश्यतां तत्र पुरमङ्गदस्य महात्मनः ।चन्द्रकेतोः सुरुचिरं चन्द्रकान्तं निरामयम् ।। ७.१०२.६ ॥
transliteration: niveśyatāṁ tatra puramaṅgadasya mahātmanaḥ ।candraketoḥ suruciraṁ candrakāntaṁ nirāmayam ।। 7.102.6 ॥

translations.english: Let a city be established there for the great-souled Angada and another, very beautiful, moon-charming, and healthy city for Chandraketu.
